$comment: Facet icons, single source for the renderer (README "Icons"). Masters = icons/ (copied from Facet main packages/icons/svg; Facet's own, MIT). tools/gen_icons.mjs rasterises every icon at every size it ships in, at both densities, to A8 alpha masks (no runtime scaling), recoloured on the device by a colour token: fw::icon(parent, "name", fw::ic::<size>, colour). Sizes: v = 720 px (Waveshare, Shelly), 1x = 480 (Guition); both on the 4 px grid. kind ui = one mask (colour = the caller's); screen = base + one accent mask; weather = one mask per colour layer, the cloud fill baked in as an occluder. Moon phase is drawn in code (Facet moonIcon), not here. pixel (optional) = the icon's 8 x 8 art for themes with shape.icons pixel: 8 rows of hex, high bit = left (tools/gen_theme.mjs -> theme_gen.h PIXEL_ICONS; drawn in whole cells by fx::icon; an icon without it stays line).

ui.$comment: opticalStroke(size): px stroke at 16/24/32/48, linear in between, clamped (Facet main packages/icons OPTICAL_STROKE)

weather.$comment: Facet main weather.ts: 2 px, 3 px from 96 px up

animated.$comment: Animated weather icons (Facet main packages/icons weather.ts + weather.css, used at 72 on the Home card and 144 on the Weather hero, 48 in the docs explorer): the same masters, cut into parts (sun rays, each cloud, each drop / flake / hailstone / star / fog or wind line, the bolt), each part rasterised on its own at these sizes (one A8 mask per colour, nothing cut out by the cloud; a cloud's bg fill becomes an occluder mask drawn in the colour behind the icon). Motion per part = motion.json weather. Not animated: the static master (fw::icon), drawn as before.

icon.use: icon inside a control: Button, rows, picker rows, readouts (size.icon = touch.icon)

glyph.use: icon buttons, back, round buttons, sheet rows, toasts, screen icons in headers (size.glyph-square / glyph-round, layout.sheet-icon)

detail.use: weather at 40 (Facet manifest; no named slot in tokens.json)

feature.use: play button glyph, empty states, weather day rows (size.glyph-play, empty-icon)

compare.$comment: the size-comparison row of the Icons page (Facet docs Icons > Optical sizes: these five at 16/24/32/48); the extra sizes these add are compare-only and left out of a used-icons-only build
